_authority: docs/PARAMETERS.md §1 + §4 and docs/GAME_DESIGN.md §3.4 — change a constant → rerun --smoke=economy → commit both (family rule).

fuel_eur_per_mwh_th._rationale: PARAMETERS §1: TTF-typical 2026 gas, API2 coal, mine-mouth lignite, full-cycle uranium.
fuel_eur_per_mwh_th._h2_rationale: P7 reference H2 fuel value (endogenous H2 book is a documented simplification: production at 52 kWh/kg from ~30 EUR/MWh power + capex share lands near 3 EUR/kg = 90 EUR/MWh_th LHV).

_co2_rationale: campaign-start ETS level (PARAMETERS §4); the campaign script ratchets it 30→250.

co2_t_per_mwh_th._rationale: PARAMETERS §1.2–1.5 emission factors on thermal energy.

capex_eur_per_kw._rationale: PARAMETERS §1 overnight capex; wind_offshore is the ARRAY-ONLY 2600 (export billed separately per §1.16/ledger 28).
capex_eur_per_kw._p7_rationale: PARAMETERS: battery 150 EUR/kW PCS + 200 EUR/kWh at the 2 h default; electrolyzer 1500 EUR/kW; converter station 350 MEUR / 2 GW; platform 800 MEUR / 2 GW (marinized).

startup_eur_per_mw._rationale: PARAMETERS §1 warm-start values as the single game constant (hot/warm/cold folded — dispatcher simplification, documented).

line_cost_meur_per_km._cable_rationale: underground 380 kV XLPE at the ledger-28 x4-over-overhead cost level; same submarine/mountain factors apply.
line_cost_meur_per_km._rationale: GAME_DESIGN §1.5; ×2.2 submarine and ×1.6 mountain applied by the builder.
line_cost_meur_per_km._hvdc_rationale: PARAMETERS 1.16: 1.4 MEUR/km overhead bipole; submarine export cable 2.0 MEUR/km applied by the builder on sea tiles (s/S).

_tariff_rationale: GAME_DESIGN §3.4: regulated tariff on DELIVERED MWh (era script raises it 95→100→105).
_treasury_rationale: sandbox/P6 default: room to build a starter grid; the campaign (P9) sets its own.

dispatch_policy._rationale: GridCo dispatcher policy numbers (GAME_DESIGN §3.3; ledger 30 makes deliverable_frac binding). They interact with the price columns above — when the campaign CO2 ratchet reprices the merit order, THESE are the thresholds that decide when batteries arbitrage and electrolyzers soak; balancing passes tune them here, not in dispatch.gd.

line_terrain_factor._rationale: GAME_DESIGN §1.5 corridor capex multipliers (billing only — physics does not care what the tower stands on). Route length itself is km × GridTopology.SINUOSITY, shared with the solved line length so the billed kilometre IS the electrical kilometre.
